item.description:
### Fixed
- Capture Text: when macOS can't read the text, it says so in the same place in the middle of the screen where «Recognizing text…» was, not in a toast in the corner. - Capture Text on macOS 27: text is read with the newer recognition of macOS 15 and later, which macOS 27's slowdown spares most of the time. When macOS still has to get its recognition ready — up to a minute — DeepSnap waits for it and says so, instead of giving up after 20 seconds; it gets it ready in the background after the Mac wakes, too. - Capturing an open menu or context menu: the selection no longer closes another app's menu as it appears, so the menu stays in an area, a timed or a window capture and in a recording. Esc and Space work over the selection as before.
